verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is a single mention that, when Decision Center is enabled, policies can be configured at the Sale checkpoint and applied to orders. That points to a first-party policy/rules capability, but nothing describes what those policies can contain or what outcomes they produce. Missing for 10: documentation that rules can reference model scores, velocity counters, list matches and transaction attributes; explicit allow/block/review outcomes; a rule-authoring interface for analysts; independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a risk analyst, I can author custom rules that combine model scores, velocity counters, list matches, and transaction attributes into allow, block, or review decisions

citations.quote: If Decision Center is enabled, policies for Sale events can be configured at the Sale checkpoint, and they will be applied to orders created via requests to this endpoint.
